errors.what: A shell heredoc in one command wrote to /mn14.py because the scratchpad variable was unset after a failed cd chain; rewrote the path

integrity_issues.issue: The Nikon NEF section said Coolpix NEFs were refused with a message to convert to DNG; in fact parse_nef accepted them and decoded 12 of 13 real Coolpix files into noise without an error. Corrected in this PR, with the old claim's correction stated next to it.
photo-editing next: said the NRW reader had 'no public sample yet'; raw.pixls.us lists NRW files for twelve Coolpix bodies. Replaced.

doc_friction.issue: 'no public sample yet' for Coolpix NRW was stale; one directory listing of raw.pixls.us/data/Nikon/ disproved it. Stale 'no sample' claims should name where they looked and when.
Says a bare python3 often lacks pytest; true here, and venture tests ran fine with python3 -m unittest with PYTHONPATH=src:tests, which is quicker than pyenv.py for a single test file.

goal: A Coolpix shooter's NRW files develop from correct sensor data instead of silently decoding to noise
notes: Coolpix NRW/E-series layouts in nef.py: 12-bit packed, 12-bit in LE32 words, 16-bit LE/BE words (top-aligned kept whole), E-series row interlace; byte order chosen from sensel smoothness on a mid-frame band; black and balance from maker-note tag 0x0014 NRW block; per-model black 200 for the 4032-wide bodies; CFA tag overridden when its green diagonal disagrees with the sensels (P6000). Verification: tools/nef_libraw_check.py on 13 raw.pixls.us Coolpix files, both engines, exit 0 (before: 12 of 13 wrong, 8.0-20.1 M sensels each); 7 D-series NEFs from metadata-extractor-images still all equal; tests/test_nef.py 29/29 with and without numpy. .nrw now a developable path. Site camera-raw-formats page, llms.txt, README updated.
